title.rendered: Click 10000mAh Magsafe Power Bank With Wireless Charger

content.rendered:
Click 10000mAh MagSafe Power Bank with Wireless Charger – Effortless Power at Your Fingertips

Stay powered all day with the Click 10000mAh MagSafe Power Bank With Wireless Charger, designed for users who demand speed, style, and reliability. Built for modern smartphones, this advanced power bank delivers magnetic wireless charging of up to 15W and wired fast charging with 20W PD output, ensuring your devices are ready whenever you need them. Whether you are at work, traveling, or on the move, this compact powerhouse brings effortless power to your fingertips.

Featuring Magnetic Wireless charging of Max 15W (5W/7.5W/10W/15W), this power bank aligns perfectly with MagSafe-compatible iPhones and Qi-enabled devices for stable, efficient charging. The strong magnetic hold keeps your phone securely attached, reducing interruptions and improving charging efficiency. Simply snap it on and experience seamless wireless power without cables.

For users who prefer speed, the Wired Fast charging of 20W PD output delivers impressive performance. It can charge iPhones up to 50% in just 30 minutes, making it ideal for busy schedules and emergency top-ups. This dual charging capability allows you to charge two devices simultaneously—one wirelessly and one via cable—maximizing convenience.

Compact Power with Premium Titanium Style

Designed with portability in mind, this power bank offers Power That Fits Anywhere. Its slim and lightweight design slips easily into pockets, handbags, or backpacks. The premium Titanium Style finish adds a modern, professional look that complements your smartphone and lifestyle. Despite its compact size, the 10000mAh capacity provides multiple charges, making it a reliable companion for daily use.

The Click 10000mAh MagSafe Power Bank With Wireless Charger is not just about performance—it’s also about trust and quality. Proudly made in India, it reflects high manufacturing standards, durable materials, and reliable battery safety features. Advanced protection safeguards against overcharging, overheating, and short circuits, ensuring safe usage for your valuable devices.

Why Choose This Magnetic Wireless Power Bank?

  • 10000mAh high-capacity battery for extended power backup
  • Magnetic Wireless charging of Max 15W (5W/7.5W/10W/15W)
  • 20W PD wired fast charging – charges iPhones 50% in 30 minutes
  • Strong magnetic alignment for secure MagSafe charging
  • Compact power design with premium Titanium Style finish
  • Dual charging support – wireless and wired simultaneously
  • Advanced safety protection for reliable everyday use
  • Proudly made in India with quality assurance

Ideal for Everyday Use and Travel

This magnetic wireless power bank is perfect for professionals, travelers, students, and anyone who relies on their smartphone throughout the day. From video calls and navigation to gaming and content creation, it ensures uninterrupted usage. Its airline-friendly capacity and lightweight build make it an excellent travel accessory.

Optimized for iPhones with MagSafe support and compatible with a wide range of Qi-enabled devices, the Click 10000mAh MagSafe Power Bank With Wireless Charger is a versatile solution for modern charging needs. With fast charging, elegant design, and dependable performance, it delivers true Effortless Power at Your Fingertips.

Upgrade your charging experience today with Compact Power that blends technology, speed, and style. Choose a smarter way to stay charged with a power bank that fits anywhere and performs everywhere.
